name: Oaș Land
summary: Oaș Land is a popular Romania, meaning a Romanian geographical, historical, and ethno-cultural region consisting of the Oaș Depression and the mountains that delimit it, the Oaș Mountains and the Gutâi Mountains with their ramifications. It is located in the north of Transylvania, in the Maramureș and Satu Mare counties.

sources.title: Ethnographic zones – Museum of the Romanian Peasant
sources.excerpt: Ethnographic area located in the north-western extremity of the country, in the north and north-east of Satu Mare county. Representative villages: Călinești Oaș and Bixad.
